title: Unused Base Table
description: Unused-code rule — base tables with no table occurrence. Without an occurrence the table is unreachable in the relationship graph.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A base table with no occurrence cannot be used on any layout or relationship.
rule.remediation: Add an occurrence if the table is needed, or delete the table.
